blogs.title: Ada Lovelace
blogs.author: The Origins of Programming
blogs.body: Long before computers existed as we know them, Ada Lovelace wrote the first algorithm intended for a machine. Her visionary thinking laid the groundwork for modern programming. This blog explores her contributions and why she's often called the world's first programmer
